narrative.text: The whole of WHO's 2009 Casebook on Ethical Issues in International Health Research, edited by Richard Cash, Daniel Wikler, Abha Saxena and Alexander Capron, extracted as one very long block. It opens with cataloguing and copyright details and guidance that the casebook is a teaching tool for instructors, whose case studies and chapter introductions may be copied for non-commercial teaching. The case studies cover ethical questions arising in international health research, with chapter introductions and suggested reading. It ends with an appendix of CIOMS–WHO ethical principles on benefits to resource-poor communities and protection of vulnerable subjects, and a note on the project's partners.
